note: Both sets capture the same core claims accurately: the second-order response of the idealized PID-controlled rotor-speed error, the roles of the derivative/proportional/integral terms under positive gains in Region 3, the generator-torque controller's negative damping, and Ref. [10]'s design recommendations (neglect derivative gain, ignore negative damping, ωφn = 0.6 rad/s, ζφ = 0.6 to 0.7). Set A, however, contains two redundant restatements (the generator-torque negative damping claim appears twice, and the second-order response claim appears twice with only trivially different attribute labels), adding bulk without new information. Set B has only one such duplication and otherwise matches A's correct content, so it is the cleaner, more faithful set. Both omit the compensation statement (negative damping must be compensated by the proportional term) and the blade-pitch sensitivity dependencies.
